title: 作品与设计记录
intro: 从整张脸的比例，看到一根线条的方向。这里保留真实模特与顾客作品；照片中的设计、妆容和拍摄阶段各不相同，不是对其他人的效果承诺。
intro_en: From whole-face proportions to the direction of a single stroke. These are real model and client work records. Designs, makeup and recording stages vary; another person’s photograph is not a promise of your result.
